title: RASS (Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale)
sources: Sessler CN et al. Am J Respir Crit Care Med 2002
purpose: Titrates sedation in real time on ventilated / critically ill patients. Also the arousal gate for CAM-ICU (delirium screen requires RASS ≥ -3).

tiers.label: +4 Combative
tiers.description: Overtly combative or violent; immediate danger to staff

tiers.label: +3 Very agitated
tiers.description: Pulls at or removes tubes/catheters; aggressive

tiers.label: +2 Agitated
tiers.description: Frequent non-purposeful movement; fights the ventilator

tiers.label: +1 Restless
tiers.description: Anxious or apprehensive but movements not aggressive/vigorous

tiers.label: -1 Drowsy
tiers.description: Not fully alert but sustained (> 10 s) awakening, eye contact, to voice

tiers.label: -2 Light sedation
tiers.description: Briefly (< 10 s) awakens with eye contact to voice

tiers.label: -3 Moderate sedation
tiers.description: Movement or eye opening to voice but no eye contact

tiers.label: -4 Deep sedation
tiers.description: No response to voice; movement or eye opening to physical stimulation

tiers.label: -5 Unarousable
tiers.description: No response to voice or physical stimulation

interpretation.label: Typical target for a comfortable ventilated patient is 0 to -2; deeper only for a specific indication (severe ARDS, refractory intracranial hypertension, neuromuscular blockade).
